answer: Deposits are visible in copper, and wander reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 20% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 49 aliases, and each one needs its own funded inlet account. The attacker spends 177 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
